verdict.rationale: Groq's first-party docs say to use OpenAI's client libraries by passing a Groq API key as `api_key` and setting `base_url` to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, which is exactly the story. The docs also claim the Responses API is fully OpenAI-compatible. They describe the API as only "mostly compatible" with OpenAI's libraries, so some parameters may differ. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the drop-in swap, and documentation of which OpenAI parameters or behaviors are unsupported.
